Metadata.title: Vashabid — Learn German
Metadata.description: Learn German with explanations in English, Bangla, or both.

Shell.tagline: A clear path into German, supported by English, Bangla, or both.

Home.title: Learn German through the language you know.
Home.description: German stays at the center. Choose English, Bangla, or both for the explanations that help you get there.
Home.foundationDescription: Interface language and learning support are separate, so you can shape each part of the experience independently.
Home.searchDescription: Search published vocabulary in German, English, or Bangla.
Home.beginnerTitle: Beginner words for A1 and A2
Home.beginnerDescription: Useful German vocabulary with learner support that follows your language choice.
Home.topicsDescription: Use familiar situations and themes to build connected German vocabulary.
Home.nextEyebrow: The next pages in your workbook
Home.nextTitle: Grammar and practice are taking shape
Home.grammarDescription: Short, focused explanations will turn German patterns into something you can use.
Home.scenariosDescription: Guided situations will help you practise German for everyday conversations.
Home.roadmapNote: More learning paths are on the way
Home.emptyWordsTitle: The word desk is being prepared
Home.emptyWordsDescription: Published German words will appear here as soon as the editorial team releases them.
Home.emptyTopicsDescription: Published vocabulary topics will appear here when they are ready.
